rubric.actions: Expected actions are mandatory. Explicit allowed_actions admit only scenario-relevant safe additions; omission or out-of-scope actions fail.
rubric.deferred: Named scoped deferrals are mandatory. Generic acceptance/completion labels are optional for non-DONE decisions because verdict/state already preserve that hold. Explicit allowed_deferred prevents unrelated scope expansion.
rubric.strict: Owner, verdict, state and every exact JSON safety boolean remain strict. Expected fixtures are not production roles metadata.
rubric.changes: Independent critics corrected semantic false-fails: C/I may rerun retained gates; B may prepare local reset; G may establish release hold; explicit-owner may report its unimplemented work as remaining. Preserved mandatory criteria mean retained prerequisites, not already-satisfied evidence; deferred means remaining work, not permission to omit it. All expected ownership/verdict/state/safety and required-action subsets remain unchanged. Historical failed runs are not upgraded.
